A kind of '''trumpet''' was peculiar to the [[Serp]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. The trumpet was long, with no valves, and ended with a flared bell. The trumpets were made of a [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] metal.
